text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: redis-maxclients-exceeded (P1) for cluster: cache-prod-eu (avg clients 10240 > maxclients 10000). triggering auto-escalation to on-call rota. http://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 created, severity: P1. Escalation policy: db-cache-team. Notification timestamps: 2100001111.

sara (oncall): acked the page. I'm looking. seeing a spike in client connections and ~20% 5xxs from api-gateway EU. Putting a hold on any non-essential deploys. :hand:

jordan: on my way, grabbing metrics. can you paste the top hosts hitting redis?

sara (oncall): running quick checks now.

sara (oncall): `redis-cli -h cache-prod-eu-001 CLIENT LIST | wc -l` -> 10236
sara (oncall): `redis-cli -h cache-prod-eu-001 CONFIG GET maxclients` -> 10000

sara (oncall): apps show connection churn, mostly from suggestions-service and realtime-sync. suggestions has a recent rollout but not sure if related.

mike: I'm watching app-side errors. suggestions-service (svc-suggest-eu) has ~50k RPS to redis with long-lived clients. seeing errors: `LOADING` and `ERR max number of clients reached` in logs.

anika: possible immediate mitigations: 1) increase maxclients on primaries (CONFIG SET) 2) force short-term eviction policy changes? 3) throttle suggestions RPS via k8s hpa or circuit-breaker.

jordan: prefer not to CONFIG SET without understanding memory/FD limits. What does `ulimit -n` / kernel allow? Also we risk file-descriptor exhaustion.

sara (oncall): agreed. quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle suggestions-service concurrency by setting `REDIS_MAX_CONN=50` env override and rolling pods (canary 20% now) 2) add temporary read-only failover to cached-read-only pool for non-critical keys 3) if still saturated, bump maxclients to 12000 and monitor FD usage.

mike: implementing suggestion throttle now. patch applied to k8s: `kubectl set env deployment/suggestions SERVICE_REDIS_MAX_CONN=40 --record` then rolling restart.

anika: monitoring: after throttle start, client count dropping to ~7200 -> good signal. 5xxs from gateway down from 22% -> 6%.

jordan: can you hold on the maxclients bump until we confirm no FD leak? I'll run `ss -s` and check process FD on redis host.

sara (oncall): doing checks. `ss -s` shows tcp: inuse 11k, orphan 0. redis process FD count at 9.8k/32k limit. kernel ulimit is 65536. looks safe to bump if needed.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded by sara (oncall). Escalation paused.

jordan: ok, we can cautiously bump to 12000 on primary 1 only, monitor for 5m. command:
```
redis-cli -h cache-prod-eu-001 CONFIG SET maxclients 12000
```
I'll run it and report.

jordan: applied to cache-prod-eu-001 -> result: OK. watching metrics.

anika: after bump + throttle, client count stabilized ~7400, errors dropped to near 0 for suggestions. latency for GET ops back to baseline.

sara (oncall): customer impact note: search suggestions (EU) experienced degraded suggestions and ~5xx for 4-7 minutes for ~3% of traffic. No data loss. Affected tenants: a subset of free-tier EU customers; enterprise tenants on dedicated caches unaffected.

mike: leaving additional short-term mitigations: added retry/backoff on client side to reduce connection bursts. Long-term: recommend adding a connection pooler library and instrumenting active clients.

jordan: handing off to sara for 30m postmortem follow-up and to coordinate with suggestions-service team for rollback review. Oncall rotation: jordan -> sara (handoff at 2100001400).

sara (oncall): ack handoff. will open INC12345 investigation ticket, assign owner for root cause (likely suggestions rollout + lack of pooling). Will post a summary to #postmortems after we gather logs.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 status: acknowledged, responders: sara (oncall), jordan, mike, anika. Next action: postmortem and remediation plan.

incident-bot: auto-note: suppressed repeat alerts for cache-prod-eu for 10m.

sara (oncall): closing out active mitigation. leaving monitoring alerts with tighter sigmas, adding dashboard widget for client count per service.

(anika reacts with :thumbsup:)

sara (oncall): final note for handoff ticket: impact window 2100001110-2100001178. ETA for full postmortem: 24h.
